title: Mocking APIs
definition: During testing, you don't want your Express server hitting real third-party APIs (like Stripe for payments or Twilio for SMS) because it costs money and slows down tests. You use mocking libraries to intercept those outgoing HTTP requests and return fake data.

answers.question: Define Mocking APIs in your own words.
answers.answer: During testing, you don't want your Express server hitting real third-party APIs (like Stripe for payments or Twilio for SMS) because it costs money and slows down tests.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Mocking APIs?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
